speaker: ELIAS
text: B-four. Same walls, same lock. If I want answers, I need people on my side.

speaker: GUARD
text: Vale! Yard is open. Stay out of trouble.

speaker: TOMAS
text: You are the new man in B-four. Tomas. Sit for a minute. Nobody survives this place alone.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Elias. I could use a friend. Or at least someone honest.

speaker: TOMAS
text: Try Niko. Blue Meridian. Malik runs his crew. The Rooks stay across the yard. Do not wander into their business.

speaker: SAMIR
text: Oi, new guy. Grab that end. These trays weigh a ton.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Got it. Where do you want them?

speaker: SAMIR
text: Right here. Thanks. Samir. You need a hot meal, come find me.

speaker: WORKSHOP CONTACT
text: Jonah. I fix whatever the guards break. Which is just about everything.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Tell me the routine. Searches, roll call... the things I should know.

speaker: WORKSHOP CONTACT
text: Whistle means count. Yard stays open till then. Play a hand, talk to people. And keep your eyes on Harrow.

speaker: GUARD
text: Enough! Back away. Both of you!

speaker: NIKO
text: Just a disagreement, officer. It is over.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Keep walking. I have it.

speaker: NIKO
text: Harrow finds that blade, I disappear into isolation. You just saved me.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Nobody saw. Let us keep it that way.

speaker: NIKO
text: You had no reason to help. I will remember that. Come on. Malik should meet you.

speaker: MALIK
text: Niko does not owe favors lightly. What do you want, Vale?

speaker: ELIAS
text: A place to stand. People I can trust.

speaker: MALIK
text: Then stand with us. Blue Meridian. We protect our own. But trust goes both ways.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Understood. I am with you.

speaker: MALIK
text: Rafi gives you our mark. After that, get the blade off the yard. Keep it in your cell.

speaker: RAFI
text: Give me your arm. First mark always stings. Do not move.

speaker: ELIAS
text: I can take it.

speaker: RAFI
text: There. Blue Meridian. Go hide that knife before Harrow changes his mind.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Under the mattress. Out of sight. Nobody touches it but me.

speaker: NIKO
text: You did what Malik asked. Here. He wants you to have this.

speaker: ELIAS
text: A phone? How did you get it in?

speaker: NIKO
text: Less you know, better you sleep. Keep it quiet. Malik will call.

speaker: MALIK
text: Vale. Signal is good. Keep this number to yourself.

speaker: ELIAS
text: I am listening.

speaker: MALIK
text: Rooks are leaning on our people again. Speak to their man in the yard. Leave the blade in your cell.

speaker: IRON ROOKS
text: Meridian gave you a new shirt and now you think you own the yard?

speaker: ELIAS
text: Nobody owns it. Leave our people alone.

speaker: IRON ROOKS
text: Come over here and say that.

speaker: GUARD
text: Hands up! All of you. Fighting stops now!

speaker: GUARD
text: Separate cells. Every one of you. Twenty-four hours in isolation.

speaker: ELIAS
text: All right. Easy. I am coming.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Twenty-four hours. Nothing to do but close my eyes.

speaker: GUARD
text: Vale! Get up. Your time is done. You have a visitor.

speaker: GUARD
text: Your brother is waiting. Come out. Walk with me.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Theo? He never comes here. What happened?

speaker: THEO
text: Elias... I am sorry. I did not know where else to go.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Hey. Breathe. Tell me what happened.

speaker: THEO
text: They took Dad. The Cinder Syndicate. The same men who put you in here.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Look at me. Was he alive when you last saw him?

speaker: THEO
text: Yes. But they said next week... if we do not pay, they will kill him.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Find somewhere safe. Stay off your phone. I am bringing him home.

speaker: THEO
text: Please. I cannot lose you both.

speaker: ELIAS
text: They framed me. Locked me away. Now they have my father.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Six days. I need a way out. Then I find him. Then we settle this.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Malik. The men who framed me took my father. I have six days. I need to get out.

speaker: MALIK
text: Everyone here wants out. Wanting it does not open a door.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Then help me build a way. Get enough people working with us. When I leave, you leave too.

speaker: MALIK
text: Cooperation. Access. The right moment. Bring me enough of those, and you have a partner.

speaker: ELIAS
text: We leave together. Before next week.

speaker: MALIK
text: Sit down. Let us work out who we can trust.

speaker: TOMAS
text: Pull up a seat. Card table is for passing time. This one is for listening.

speaker: ELIAS
text: What do the guards miss?

speaker: TOMAS
text: Things right in front of them. Who talks to who. Who owes who. Learn the people first.

speaker: SAMIR
text: A friendly hand? Five-card draw. Keep what you like. We play for bragging rights.

speaker: TOMAS
text: Counts in ten minutes. Plenty of time for another hand.

speaker: SAMIR
text: My cooking is better than my cards. That is not saying much.

speaker: WORKSHOP CONTACT
text: Work detail at the next whistle. Do not be late.

speaker: NIKO
text: Keep your voice down. Harrow hears more than you think.

speaker: MALIK
text: Every favor gets remembered. Good and bad.

speaker: NIKO
text: Back off. You do not own this yard.

speaker: GUARD
text: Break it up! Hands where I can see them!
